findings.text: follow-on: the after_suite arm runs the new acceptance test while the baseline arm (manifest.md:16) is the three importer modules, so the two gate logs the added-failure derivation reads are different test populations and the count is vacuous; the matching head arm (head-importer-arm.log, 50/92/96 passed) exists but is not named by after_suite.

follow-on: _commits_missing_from(checkout, commits) returns an empty list when the manifest names no commits, so acceptance proceeds to the merged-head gate re-run without confirming the run is on the branch; all four cases name a commit, so acceptance's 'never merges, stands down for an unmerged run' property is untested for a commit-less manifest.

item_verdicts.diff: read commit by commit against base 3e91424667 -- a5779361 the accepting branch, e93b268b the ancestor guard, 6f8fbd0c the evidence fragment; 678 insertions across five files, no runtime change outside the declared scope.
item_verdicts.done_when: the done_when names three cases; tests/test_review_acceptance_promotes.py:264 (a clean review promotes), :279 (a review carrying one finding does not promote) and :300 (a gate failing at the merged head does not promote) all exist and pass; the manifest records 6 passed EXIT=0 and I re-ran the file at the reviewed head to the same 6 passed.
item_verdicts.goal: the node's goal is plan section 4 of a-review-is-sized-to-its-risk -- a clean stored review promotes the run it read with no coordinator command; reckon/crew/recovery.py:2813 accept_clean_review, reached by the sweep at recovery.py:3044, adds the accepting branch beside the promotion refusal.
item_verdicts.manifest: read; status complete, records the head arm 6 passed and the importer arms 50/92/96 passed, names its gate command and negative-control logs; its baseline_suite/after_suite pairing is mismatched (see finding).
item_verdicts.write_paths: the manifest declares five write paths; every path in the diff (reckon/crew/promotion.py, reckon/crew/recovery.py, reckon/ledger.py, tests/test_review_acceptance_promotes.py, the evidence fragment) is inside them.

justifications.durability: recovery.py:2718 REVIEW_ACCEPTANCE_FLOOR is the floor; removing the accepting branch reddens three cases and removing the ancestor check reddens tests/test_review_acceptance_promotes.py:322 (both negative-control logs EXIT=1), but the ancestor guard is vacuous for a manifest naming no commit.
justifications.evidence: the three done_when cases exist at tests/test_review_acceptance_promotes.py:264, 279 and 300 and pass (I re-ran the file at the reviewed head: 6 passed), but the manifest's baseline_suite (importer modules) and after_suite (the acceptance test) are different test populations, so the recorded added-failure pair is vacuous.
justifications.fit: recovery.py:2716-2740 follows the module's constant-then-helper idiom, the comment at ledger.py:154 is mechanism-focused, and no symbol or comment names a plan, sprint or ticket identifier.
justifications.goal_fidelity: recovery.py:2860 requires the run's commits to be ancestors of the checkout HEAD and acceptance never merges, so the plan's 'with the run merged' is enforced as a precondition a coordinator must satisfy and the fresh post-review state the node itself records at tests/test_review_acceptance_promotes.py:241 stands down.
justifications.scope_discipline: the five changed paths are exactly the manifest's declared write paths and the diff touches nothing else.
